responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from marketing platforms, Salesforce, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
Develop data transformations and models that provide trusted, well-structured datasets for downstream analytics, reporting, dashboarding, and advanced modelling.
Build and maintain API-based integrations and custom Python solutions to support reliable and automated data ingestion.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations.
Create and maintain technical documentation, metadata, data definitions, and lineage to improve the discoverability, usability, and governance of data assets.
Build and structure datasets and documentation to support AI and LLM use cases, while leveraging AI tools throughout development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation workflows.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Every responsibility is framed around reliability and correctness - 'scalable, reliable data pipelines', 'trusted, well-structured datasets', a full bullet on validation and testing - and no velocity phrase appears at all.
evidence.domain_risk: Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from marketing platforms, Salesforce, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Marketing and campaign data feeding analytics and attribution - errors affect commercial decisions, and privacy/consent governance appears only as a nice-to-have rather than a role obligation.
evidence.collaboration_width: No distinctly named partner teams or functions appear anywhere in the JD.
evidence.data_team_maturity: 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar data-focused engineering role.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The posting assumes an existing production estate - production-grade pipelines, enterprise data sources, an established cloud data platform - but describes no team structure or founding mission.
evidence.jd_authorship: Experience integrating data through REST APIs and other programmatic data sources, including authentication, pagination, error handling, schema changes, and monitoring.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The detail level is engineer-written throughout - pagination and schema-change handling, Salesforce underlying data structures, named ingestion tools like Rivery and Boomi.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Experience working with marketing data and marketing technology ecosystems, including integrating data across CRM, campaign, digital, media, or customer platforms.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The entire data domain is commercial - marketing platforms, Salesforce, CRM, campaign measurement and marketing attribution.
evidence.autonomy_level: Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from marketing platforms, Salesforce, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: All six responsibilities are build-and-maintain delivery verbs with no define, establish, own or strategy-setting language - consistent with the contract framing.
evidence.ai_role: Build and structure datasets and documentation to support AI and LLM use cases, while leveraging AI tools throughout development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation workflows.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Both signals are present in a single bullet - building AI/LLM-ready datasets and using AI tools day-to-day - and the tie-breaker resolves to ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality is an owned responsibility bullet with an 'Ensure' verb covering validation, testing and monitoring, not a tool named in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Experience with data validation, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining reliable production pipelines.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The risk register is operational - pipeline availability, production reliability and troubleshooting - rather than compliance exposure or stakeholder trust.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build and maintain API-based integrations and custom Python solutions to support reliable and automated data ingestion.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Every infrastructure task is a build verb creating new pipelines, integrations, models and documentation, with no legacy, migration or remediation language.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations - the fear expressed is pipeline failure and unavailable data rather than regulatory or reputational exposure. Note: this is a contract role advertised by a technology staffing firm, so the end client is not named.
